4.text: Aˊtal-taˊn˙ñɪtan is applied to the Chuvantzy. Aˊtal (eˊtel)² is the name

5.text: these people give to themselves at the present time. Krasheninnikoff gives

6.text: it as the Koryak name for the Yukaghir, which certainly agrees with the

7.text: data I have already given concerning the Chuvantzy.

8.text: In contrast to all these Taˊn˙ñɪt, the Chukchee often call the Koryak

9.text: Lɪˊê-taˊn˙ñɪt (“genuine Taˊn˙ñɪt”) in the same way, perhaps, as they call them-

19.text: Sometimes the Russians are also called Leˊlu-reˊmkɪn (“bearded people”), whence

20.text: the Asiatic Eskimo term laˊlo-reˊmka. Americans also are called Pnauˊkulɪt

22.text: sometimes called even Taˊn˙ñɪt, like the Russians.

25.text: name is unknown. It can hardly have anything in common with Koryak, —
